title: TCL 50EP680 (Europe), `ro.product.model` BeyondTV, brand TCL, board `rtd285o` (Realtek),
notes:
TCL 50EP680 (Europe), `ro.product.model` BeyondTV, brand TCL, board `rtd285o` (Realtek),
Android TV 11 (API 30), build `PPR1.180610.011` / incremental `AR05`, dated 2022-05-26,
security patch 2021-12-05, 32-bit (`armeabi-v7a`), locale `en-GB`.
Fingerprint: TCL/BeyondTV/BeyondTV:11/PPR1.180610.011/AR05:user/release-keys

Apply:   TV_HOST=<tv ip> tools/disable.sh examples/tcl-50ep680/debloat.txt
Undo:    TV_HOST=<tv ip> tools/restore.sh examples/tcl-50ep680/debloat.txt
Stock launcher: com.google.android.tvlauncher (this is Android TV 11, not Google TV, so no
com.google.android.apps.tv.launcherx and no setupwraith here). Both tools' defaults fit unchanged.
Live TV app: com.tcl.tv (owns tuner/HDMI playback; the launcher offers it at the end of the Inputs
menu). Keep it and com.tcl.tvinput.

Already disabled at the factory on this firmware, so no action is needed and none of them are
listed below: every uk.co.freeview.* UK catch-up app (14 of them), com.tcl.smartalexa,
com.graymatrix.did, tv.wuaki.apptv, com.tcl.gallery, com.google.android.apps.nbu.smartconnect.tv,
com.eros.now. (Same pattern as the BeyondTV2 Latin America profile: the UK catch-up apps are
pre-disabled on TCL sets sold outside the UK.)

Deliberately NOT disabled (ambiguous or system-relevant): com.tcl.autopair (Bluetooth remote
pairing), com.tcl.guard, com.tcl.messagebox, com.tcl.usercenter, com.tcl.useragreement,
com.tcl.xian.StartandroidService, com.tcl.browser, casting (com.google.android.apps.mediashell,
com.tcl.miracast, com.tcl.MultiScreenInteraction_TV, com.google.android.tv.remote.service),
firmware updates (com.tcl.versionUpdateApp), the streaming apps (Netflix, YouTube, YouTube Kids,
Disney+, com.wbd.stream = HBO Max, Spotify, VLC, Firefox, Czech Television iVysilani, SledovaniTV,
Stream.cz, FilmBox), file managers (Total Commander, X-plore, FX, WiFi File Explorer), the sideload
launcher, Zoom, and the Play Store (com.android.vending).

Voice assistant is off by choice on this set (one user's pick, grouped so others can comment it
out): com.google.android.katniss, com.google.android.tv.assistant, com.tcl.assistant. That turns
the remote's voice button into a no-op.

Testing: applied on a real unit on 2026-10-19, every package disabled through tools/disable.sh and
then re-checked one by one (`pm list packages -e`: 47/47 disabled, 0 failures). Home, the app grid,
the Inputs menu (HDMI 1-3, AV, Live TV), the Wi-Fi pill and Settings all kept working afterwards,
and a dock app was launched and closed to confirm tiles start apps. The set was not rebooted
afterwards and this list has NOT been lived with for days yet.
